tasks.name: Install tread protection
tasks.notes: FIRST task — before any other work. Ram Board Stair Armor or equivalent non-slip protection. Secure with low-tack Safe-Release tape. NEVER use plastic sheeting — extreme fall hazard per Stairway_Systems_Doctrine Section 6.2.

tasks.name: Install landing floor protection
tasks.notes: Canvas drop cloth runners at landing areas. Not needed on subfloor.

tasks.name: Mask walls along stringer edge
tasks.notes: Wall masking along stringer top edge. Required for spray method. Also required for brush when walls are SS_PAINTED_*.

sop_modules.name: Surface Preparation
sop_modules.notes: Prep tasks vary by substrate. Stringer tasks first, then riser tasks per canonical sequence. Caulk after fill/sand, before primer.

tasks.name: Sand stringers per substrate
tasks.notes: Bare substrates: 150-220 grit depending on substrate. Factory-primed: scuff sand 150-180 grit. Stringer surfaces done first per canonical sequence (#4 before #8).

tasks.name: Sand risers per substrate
tasks.notes: Bare substrates: 150-220 grit. Factory-primed: scuff sand 150-180. Risers done after stringers per canonical sequence.

tasks.name: Remove sanding dust (tack cloth / vacuum)
tasks.notes: Thorough dust removal after all sanding. Tack cloth all surfaces. Vacuum treads/landings.

tasks.name: Fill fastener holes and minor defects
tasks.notes: Fill nail/screw holes on risers and stringers. QT3: fill obvious holes. QT4: fill all visible holes. QT5: fill all holes regardless of size.

tasks.name: Sand filled areas smooth
tasks.notes: Sand all filled areas flush with 220 grit. QT5: check with raking light.

tasks.name: Caulk stringer-to-wall junction
tasks.notes: Continuous linear caulk joint where closed stringer meets wall. Mandatory for closed stringers — highly visible junction. Paintable acrylic latex caulk, 1/8 to 1/4 inch bead.

tasks.name: Caulk riser-to-stringer junctions
tasks.notes: 2 joints per riser (left + right stringer edge). Fills visible gaps at riser-to-stringer junction. Caulk LF derived: riser_count × 2 × riser_width.

tasks.name: Seal MDF cut/routed edges (solvent-based)
tasks.notes: MANDATORY step 1 of MDF two-step prime. Shellac or oil-based sealer on all cut/routed edges. Water-based causes irreversible fiber swelling. Must complete BEFORE any latex primer. Per Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine Section 2.

sop_modules.name: Primer Application
sop_modules.notes: CONDITIONAL — only runs when substrate_state = SS_BARE. Factory-primed substrates skip this module. Primer type driven by substrate. Stringers before risers.

tasks.name: Prime stringer surfaces
tasks.notes: Primer system selected by substrate: MDF=SYS_PRIMER_MDF_LATEX (faces, after edge seal), poplar=SYS_PRIMER_POPLAR_STAINBLOCK, hardwood=SYS_PRIMER_HARDWOOD_TANNINBLOCK, plywood=SYS_PRIMER_PLYWOOD_SEALER. Stringers first per canonical sequence.

tasks.name: Prime riser surfaces
tasks.notes: Same primer system as stringers. Risers are vertical surfaces — thin coat, no runs. Risers after stringers per canonical sequence.

tasks.name: Light sand primer for adhesion
tasks.notes: 220 grit light sand entire primed surface for finish coat adhesion. Tack cloth after sanding.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat Application
sop_modules.notes: Finish coat applied to all surfaces. Stringers before risers per canonical sequence. Brush is default method. Apply, tip once, walk away (FFD 15.3.1). Risers are vertical — watch for runs.

tasks.name: Brush finish coat on stringers
tasks.notes: Stringers first per canonical sequence. Apply, tip once, walk away. Consistent coverage along full length. Open stringers: follow notched profile carefully.

tasks.name: Brush finish coat on risers
tasks.notes: Risers after stringers. Vertical surface — thin coat essential. Check each riser for sags before moving to next. Proper brush loading critical.

tasks.name: Spray finish coat on stringers
tasks.notes: Stringers first. Tight fan pattern. Keep moving to avoid runs. Requires wall masking.

tasks.name: Spray finish coat on risers
tasks.notes: Risers after stringers. Light passes on vertical surface. Keep gun moving.

sop_modules.name: Between-Coat Interstage
sop_modules.notes: Runs after every coat EXCEPT the final coat. Universal at ALL quality tiers. Sanding discipline varies by QT: QT3=spot only, QT4=full 220, QT5=full 220-320.

tasks.name: Clean work area between coats
tasks.notes: Remove dust, debris from treads and landings. Ensure clean environment for next coat.

tasks.name: Inspect previous coat
tasks.notes: QT3: quick glance at 6ft — obvious defects. QT4: systematic scan at 3ft — all visible defects marked. QT5: lighted critical inspection at arm's length — zero tolerance.

tasks.name: Sand between coats
tasks.notes: QT3: spot sand nibs/rough spots only. QT4: full 220 grit entire surface. QT5: thorough 220-320 grit, uniform scratch pattern. Rigid sanding block mandatory for defect removal (FFD 15.4.1).

tasks.name: Patch and repair marked defects
tasks.notes: Fill, sand, and spot-prime any defects found during inspection. Scope varies by QT.

tasks.name: Spot coat patched areas
tasks.notes: Touch-up patched areas to match surrounding finish before next full coat.

tasks.name: Tack cloth all surfaces
tasks.notes: Remove all sanding dust with tack cloth before next coat application.

tasks.name: Final quality inspection
tasks.notes: QT3: scan for obvious defects. QT4: systematic review of all surfaces. QT5: critical inspection with light at arm's length. Check riser-to-stringer junction, stringer-to-wall caulk lines, surface finish quality.

tasks.name: Touch-up defects found during final inspection
tasks.notes: Correct any remaining defects. Feather touch-ups into surrounding finish.

tasks.name: Remove wall masking
tasks.notes: Score tape edge before removal. Pull at 45-degree angle.

tasks.name: Remove floor protection at landings
tasks.notes: Remove canvas drops from landing areas.

tasks.name: Remove tread protection
tasks.notes: LAST task. Remove Ram Board Stair Armor carefully. Score tape edges. May DEFER removal if railing or tread work follows — tread protection continuity is critical.

tasks.name: Clean tools and equipment
tasks.notes: Clean brushes, spray equipment, dispose of consumables. Water cleanup for waterborne products.

zones.notes: Mandatory from Day 1. Removal may be deferred.

workflow_sequence.standard_bare: MOD_STRS_SETUP → MOD_STRS_PREP → MOD_STRS_PRIME → MOD_STRS_INTERSTAGE → MOD_STRS_FINISH_COAT(1) → MOD_STRS_INTERSTAGE → MOD_STRS_FINISH_COAT(2) → MOD_STRS_FINAL_INSPECT → MOD_STRS_CLEANUP
workflow_sequence.standard_factory_primed: MOD_STRS_SETUP → MOD_STRS_PREP → MOD_STRS_FINISH_COAT(1) → MOD_STRS_INTERSTAGE → MOD_STRS_FINISH_COAT(2) → MOD_STRS_FINAL_INSPECT → MOD_STRS_CLEANUP
workflow_sequence.qt5_brush_roll: MOD_STRS_SETUP → MOD_STRS_PREP → [MOD_STRS_PRIME] → [MOD_STRS_INTERSTAGE] → MOD_STRS_FINISH_COAT(1) → MOD_STRS_INTERSTAGE → MOD_STRS_FINISH_COAT(2) → MOD_STRS_INTERSTAGE → MOD_STRS_FINISH_COAT(3) → MOD_STRS_FINAL_INSPECT → MOD_STRS_CLEANUP
workflow_sequence.notes: Prime module conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE. QT5 brush/roll adds additional FINISH_COAT + INTERSTAGE cycle. Within each coat module: stringers before risers per canonical sequence.

canonical_sequence_enforcement.rule: Stringers (#4) MUST be completed before risers (#8) within every module
canonical_sequence_enforcement.rationale: Painting stringers first avoids contact with wet riser surfaces when moving between treads.
